input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。
CURRENT SCENE:
他难怪抱怨，他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市。他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师。跟老师孟子学最重要的文学，所以他成为哲学家。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P142] 【他】想他的朋友
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [-他]想他的朋友 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]想帮他们 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-他]想帮忙 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]想找工作
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P143] 因为【他】不要离开他的城市
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 因为[-他]不要离开他的城市 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (directional_complements): 他[回了→回到了]他的城市
  her past correction (directional_complements): 所以他们[到城市的外边搬家了→搬到城市外了]
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-他要回家]
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card directional_complements: Use V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去: put the place after the directional complement and before 来/去. For walking to a place, use 走到place来/去, not 走去 or 走来Place. Not an error: Do not treat 拿起来 and 拿上去 as interchangeable word-order forms: 拿起来 means “pick up,” while 拿上去 means “bring it up.”

[P144] 因为他【不要】离开他的城市
  proposed by the AI checker: 因为他[不要→不想]离开他的城市 (不想 means “does not want to”)
  proposed by the correction model: 因为他不[要→想]离开他的城市
  her past correction (directional_complements): 所以他们[到城市的外边搬家了→搬到城市外了]
  her past correction (directional_complements): 他[回了→回到了]他的城市
  her past correction (le_completed): 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  rule card directional_complements: Use V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去: put the place after the directional complement and before 来/去. For walking to a place, use 走到place来/去, not 走去 or 走来Place. Not an error: Do not treat 拿起来 and 拿上去 as interchangeable word-order forms: 拿起来 means “pick up,” while 拿上去 means “bring it up.”
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P145] 他的妈妈找到【^】孟子一个老师
  proposed by the AI checker: 他的妈妈找到[+给]孟子一个老师 (the person receiving the teacher needs 给)
  proposed by the correction model: 他的妈妈找到[+一个教]孟子一个老师
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-孟子的妈妈]告诉孟子 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P146] 他的妈妈找到孟子【一个】老师
  proposed by the correction model: 他的妈妈找到孟子[一个→的]老师
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 有一个[男孩子叫孟子→叫孟子的男孩子]和他的妈妈
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card addition_repetition_connectors: Use 又 for something that happened again, 也 for similarity, 还 for an added or surprising point, and 并 to make an addition more coherent. Put 也 after the subject (Subj.也), and put 又 before a modal V. (又+ modal V.). Not an error: Do not add an additive connector when the sentence does not show repetition, similarity, or an added point. Use 就, not 还, for a natural continuation rather than a surprising or angry one.

[P147] 【跟老师孟子】学最重要的文学
  proposed by the AI checker: [跟老师孟子→孟子跟老师]学最重要的文学 (the subject should come before 跟老师)
  her past correction (laoshi_negative_repetition): 孟子[跟老师老是学习中文→一直学习中文] — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): ⟦所以⟧孟子会跟别的教授学哲学 — her note: 这样in this way
  her past correction (laoshi_negative_repetition): 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  rule card laoshi_negative_repetition: 老是 means “always” and is used for something negative or to complain; for a neutral or positive repeated action, use 一直 or 常常 instead. Not an error: Use 老是 when the repeated action is negative or the speaker is complaining about it. Do not flag it merely because it means “always.”
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).

[P148] 所以他成为【^】哲学家
  proposed by the correction model: 所以他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction (le_completed): 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): 他[+后来]成为哲学家
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 而是成为[哲学人→哲学家]
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card time_sequence_markers: Use Time + 以后 after a completed time or action to show “after”; when moving to a later event in the story, use 后来 or 然后 rather than 以后 by itself. Do not add 以后 when the time phrase already says the time clearly. Not an error: Do not use 结果 merely as a general later-time connector; it is for an unexpected result. Use 后来 for a later development instead.

places.reason: Repeated subject in a close continuation.
The same subject is already clear.
不想, not 不要, expresses that he does not want to leave.
The recipient needs a benefactive construction.
Changing it to 的 would alter the intended meaning.
孟子 must be the subject before 跟老师.
Becoming a philosopher is a completed change of state.
